segments.text: Your open- source project is drowning in AI generated garbage PRs from people who don't understand the code. Mitchell Hashimoto built Vouch to fix that.
Explicit trust system where users have to be vouched for by trusted community members before they can contribute.
Maintain a flat file list of vouched and denounced users. GitHub actions autoclose PRs from unvouched people.
Collaborators can vouch or denounce via issue comments.
